quests.title: The Elder's Amulet
quests.description: Thieves hid Elder Maren's amulet in the old cellar beneath the chapel ruins, east of the river. Bring it back.

objectives.text: Find the amulet in the old cellar
Bring the amulet to Elder Maren

quests.title: Glowcaps for Wren
quests.description: Wren the herbalist needs glowcaps for her remedies. They grow in the dark of the cellar.

quests.title: Pest Control
quests.description: Farmer Tom says rats from the cellar are eating his grain.
